{{Short description|French mathematician (born 1952)}}
'''Daniel Bennequin''' (3 January 1952) is a French mathematician, known for the [[Thurston–Bennequin number]] (sometimes called the Bennequin number) introduced in his doctoral dissertation.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://katlas.math.toronto.edu/wiki/Maximal_Thurston-Bennequin_number |title=Maximal Thurston-Bennequin number - Knot Atlas |access-date=2015-10-16 |archive-date=2015-10-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151018120101/http://katlas.math.toronto.edu/wiki/Maximal_Thurston-Bennequin_number }}</ref>

==Education and career==
Bennequin completed his secondary education at [[Lycée Condorcet]] and then graduated from the [[École normale supérieure]]. He received his [[habilitation]] (Doctoral d'Etat) in 1982 from the [[University of Paris VII]] under [[Alain Chenciner]] with thesis ''Entrelacements et équations de Pfaff''.<ref>{{cite journal|title=Entrelacements et équations de Pfaff|journal=Astérisque|volume=107/108|year=1983|pages=87–161}} (Bennequin's doctoral dissertation)</ref><ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=56580}}</ref> He was a professor at the [[University of Strasbourg]] before becoming a professor at the University of Paris VII (Institut Mathématique de Jussieu).

Bennequin's dissertation was a major contribution to [[contact geometry]], in which he gave the first example of an exotic contact structure embedded in Euclidean 3-space. On the basis of their work in the 1980s Bennequin and [[Yakov Eliashberg]] might be considered the founders of contact topology.<ref>[[Adrien Douady]]: ''Noeuds et structures de contact en dimension 3, d'après Daniel Bennequin'', Seminaire Bourbaki 604, 1982/83, [http://www.numdam.org/numdam-bin/fitem?id=SB_1982-1983__25__129_0 numdam] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160406235320/http://www.numdam.org/numdam-bin/fitem?id=SB_1982-1983__25__129_0 |date=2016-04-06 }}</ref> Bennequin also works on [[motion planning]].<ref>{{cite journal|author=Bennequin, Daniel|author2=Fuchs, Ronit|author3=Berthoz, Alain|author4=Flash, Tamar|author4-link=Tamar Flash|title=Movement Timing and Invariance Arise from Several Geometries|journal=PLOS Comput Biol|volume=5|issue=7|date=10 July 2009|article-number=e1000426|doi=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1000426|pmid=19593380|pmc=2702097|bibcode=2009PLSCB...5E0426B |doi-access=free }}</ref> He was a member of [[Nicolas Bourbaki|Bourbaki]].<ref>{{citation|title=Bourbaki: a secret society of mathematicians|first=Maurice|last=Mashaal|publisher=[[American Mathematical Society]]|year=2006|page=17|isbn=978-0-8218-3967-6|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=-CXn6y_1nJ8C&pg=PA17}}</ref>

* ''L'instanton gordien, d'après P. B. Kronheimer et T. S. Mrowka'', Séminaire Bourbaki Nr. 770, 1992/93, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160410162407/http://www.numdam.org/numdam-bin/fitem?id=SB_1992-1993__35__233_0 numdam]
* ''Monopôles de Seiberg-Witten et conjecture de Thom, d'après Kronheimer, Mrowka et Witten'', Séminaire Bourbaki Nr. 807, 1995/96, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160304103734/http://www.numdam.org/numdam-bin/fitem?id=SB_1995-1996__38__59_0 numdam]
* ''Caustique mystique, d'après Arnold et al.'',  Séminaire Bourbaki, Nr. 634, 1984/85, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160905163125/http://www.numdam.org/numdam-bin/fitem?id=SB_1984-1985__27__19_0 numdam]
* ''Problèmes elliptiques, surfaces de Riemann et structures symplectiques, d'après M. Gromov'', Séminaire Bourbaki, Nr. 657, 1985/86, [https://web.archive.org/web/20170118093051/http://www.numdam.org/numdam-bin/fitem?id=SB_1985-1986__28__111_0 numdam]
* ''Topologie symplectique, convexité holomorphe et structures de contact, d'après Y. Eliashberg, D. Mc Duff et al'', Séminaire Bourbaki, Nr. 725, 1989/90, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160304121259/http://www.numdam.org/numdam-bin/fitem?id=SB_1989-1990__32__285_0 numdam]
* ''Dualités de champs et de cordes, d'après t'Hooft, Polyakov, Witten et al.'', Séminaire Bourbaki, Nr. 899, 2001/02, [https://web.archive.org/web/20160304104435/http://www.numdam.org/numdam-bin/fitem?id=SB_2001-2002__44__117_0 numdam]
* ''Les Bords des revêtements ramifiés des surfaces'', ENS 1977
